---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear description of the problem. Ex: "I'm always frustrated when […]"

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What should happen, concretely. If it's a game profile request, use this format:

```json
{
  "name": "Game Title",
  "executable": "game.exe",
  "notes": "what the game is heavy on (CPU-bound, RAM-hungry, shader stutter)"
}
```

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Other tools or workarounds you've tried.

**Which problem category does this fit?**
- [ ] New game profile
- [ ] New optimization technique
- [ ] UI/UX improvement
- [ ] Performance of TurboFPS itself
- [ ] Other

**Additional context**
Screenshots, links to documentation of the tweak, benchmark data if you have it.
